title: Kissed Gooey Mexican Corn Elote
description: A comforting Mexican dish featuring grilled corn, chicken stock, and nuka-pickle, all combined in a dairy-free friendly elote form, balancing bitter and gooey flavors.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grill corn on the cob for 10-12 minutes, turning every 2 minutes, until lightly charred.
In a large bowl, whisk together chicken stock, nuka-pickle, olive oil, lime juice, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Once corn is grilled, let it cool for a minute, then brush the chicken stock mixture evenly onto each ear of corn.
Spread vegan mayonnaise onto each ear of corn, making sure to cover the entire surface.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the mayonnaise-covered corn.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
For an extra crispy texture, place the corn under the broiler for 1-2 minutes after applying the mayonnaise and cilantro.
Keep an eye on the corn while it is under the broiler to avoid burning.
Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
